data.name: UNWIELDY
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for a new level of sports madness! UNWIELDY - is a dynamic 3D fighting game in which every movement is dictated by realistic physics, and every victory brings incredible satisfaction. Forget about memorized button combinations: here, timing, distance, and the ability to use your body's momentum are what matter.

KEY FEATURES:

Physics as the basis of combat: Every collision, fall, and blow is calculated in real time. Enjoy unpredictable and spectacular battles where the outcome depends on your reflexes.

Sport without limits: Choose your style and enter arenas inspired by various sports. But remember: in this competition, the winner is the one who stays on their feet last.

Play with friends anywhere: With full support for Remote Play Together, online multiplayer, and local mode (Shared/Split Screen), you can have a brawl with your friends, even if only one of you has purchased the game!

Online Multiplayer: Up to 8 players on 1 map.

Local Shared/Split Screen: Up to 2 players.

Spectacular 3D battles: The spectacular third-person camera lets you immerse yourself in the thick of the action and control every inch of the arena.

Old-school beat 'em up with a new twist: The spirit of classic arcade fighting meets modern technology and deep interaction mechanics.

Can you tame the chaos and become an arena legend? Get ready to fight — the battle is about to begin!

data.short_description: A physics-based 3D combat sports game where chaos reigns supreme! Hit the arena, master the momentum, and crush your friends in local or online multiplayer. No rules, just pure physics-driven action.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: A controller might be also used
